decrypt-pdf-with-owner-password__v2.title: Decrypt PDF with Owner Password using Aspose.Pdf
decrypt-pdf-with-owner-password__v2.description: Shows how to open an encrypted PDF with the owner password, decrypt it using Aspose.Pdf, and save the unprotected document.

decrypt-pdf-using-owner-password.title: Decrypt PDF Using Owner Password with Aspose.Pdf
decrypt-pdf-using-owner-password.description: Shows how to open an encrypted PDF with the owner password, remove its encryption using Document.Decrypt, and save the resulting unprotected PDF.

decrypt-encrypted-pdf-using-owner-passwo.title: Decrypt Encrypted PDF Using Owner Password
decrypt-encrypted-pdf-using-owner-passwo.description: Shows how to open an encrypted PDF with the owner password, decrypt it using Document.Decrypt(), and save the unprotected PDF.

decrypt-pdf-if-encrypted.title: Decrypt PDF if Encrypted and Save
decrypt-pdf-if-encrypted.description: Loads a PDF file, checks whether it is encrypted, decrypts it when needed, and saves the resulting document.

decrypt-pdf-with-owner-password__v3.title: Decrypt PDF with Owner Password
decrypt-pdf-with-owner-password__v3.description: Shows how to open an encrypted PDF using the owner password, remove its security restrictions, and save an unprotected copy with Aspose.Pdf for .NET.

decrypt-pdf-change-passwords.title: Decrypt PDF and Change Passwords
decrypt-pdf-change-passwords.description: Demonstrates opening an encrypted PDF with the owner password, decrypting it, then re‑encrypting with new user and owner passwords and saving the result.
